SYNTHETIC DOCUMENT — written for the corpus extraction tests. It is fiction: the operator, the case number, the unit and every date below exist nowhere, it carries no legal authority, and no claim extracted from it describes the real market.

The Example Market Operator announces that, pursuant to Example Case No. 2026-001 RC, the commercial dispatch and settlement of the Example Reserve Market is suspended from 2027-02-01 until further notice.

During the suspension, reserve requirements continue to be sourced through existing Example Service Agreements and other designated arrangements.

The Example Regulator targets a review of the Example Reserve Market design and pricing framework by 2027-06-30.

The registered maximum available capacity of the fictional unit EXAMPLE-U2 is 83.7 MW, and the unit remains registered while the review is pending.

The Example Market Operator will publish its reserve market reports under a new product family it calls the Example Reserve Product.
